page.title: Billing
page.description: What {{name}} pays for Qeet ID, and the invoices for it.
page.descriptionNoName: What your organisation pays for Qeet ID, and the invoices for it.

checkout.success: The plan changes once your provider confirms the payment. This page shows the latest the server has.
checkout.cancelled: Nothing was paid, and the plan hasn't changed.

line.free: No charge · free for as long as you like
line.trialEnded: The trial ended on {{date}}, so you're on Free until you choose a plan.
line.none: No subscription on record, so nothing is charged here.

trial.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
trial.line: No card needed. You go back to Free when it ends, unless you choose a paid plan.

change.title: Change plan
change.description: Prices are before tax. A paid plan is paid with your payment provider, and starts once the payment goes through.
change.freeBlocked: Usage couldn't be checked, so Free can't be chosen yet.

confirm.title: Switch to {{name}}?

paid.month: You'll pay {{price}} a month before tax, with your payment provider. {{name}} starts when the payment goes through and runs a month from then; nothing is credited for what's left of {{current}}.
paid.year: You'll pay {{price}} a year before tax, with your payment provider. {{name}} starts when the payment goes through and runs a year from then; nothing is credited for what's left of {{current}}.

start.month: You'll pay {{price}} a month before tax, with your payment provider. {{name}} starts when the payment goes through and runs a month from then.
start.year: You'll pay {{price}} a year before tax, with your payment provider. {{name}} starts when the payment goes through and runs a year from then.

confirm.free: Free starts now. You keep what you have, but can't add more past Free's limits; nothing is refunded for what's left of {{current}}.
confirm.freeOverTitle: Switch to Free with more than it allows?
confirm.freeOver: You have {{resources}}. Free starts now: they stay, but you can't add more until you're under its limits. Nothing is refunded for what's left of {{current}}.

usage.title: Usage
usage.unlimited: {{plan}} has no limits on these. Seats are people with a role, plus pending invitations.
usage.limited: Against {{plan}}'s limits. Seats are people with a role, plus pending invitations.

details.title: Billing details
details.description: Who your invoices are made out to. The country, state and tax ID set the tax on each new invoice.
details.emptyLine: The legal name, address and tax ID for your invoices.
details.placeOfSupply: Place of supply on your invoices: {{place}}
details.panelDescription: Changes apply to invoices issued from now on.
details.emailHint: Kept with your details. Qeet ID doesn't email invoices to it.
details.stateHint: On an Indian invoice, the state is the place of supply.
details.gstinHint: 15 characters. Saving it doesn't verify the registration.
details.vatHint: Saving it doesn't verify the registration.
details.gstinError: Enter a 15-character GSTIN: digits and capital letters.

payment.title: Payment method
payment.name: Collected at checkout
payment.line: Your payment provider holds the payment details, so they don't show here.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Newest first, up to the last 100.
invoices.emptyDescription: An invoice is issued each time a plan starts, Free included.
invoices.copyFailed: The invoice ID couldn't be copied

cancel.title: Cancel subscription
cancel.description: {{plan}} is paid for until {{date}}. Cancelling marks it to end then; nothing is refunded.
cancel.confirmDescription: {{plan}} stays until {{date}}, the end of the period paid for, so nothing changes for your people before then. Nothing is refunded.
